messages:
noah: Hey team — starting today as a Product Designer! Quick access Qs: I don't see a Figma invite, Notion shows 403 for /Product, and I can't find the UX research templates. Who should I ping? Also where do we keep user session recordings?

amy: welcome @noah :tada: I can help with Figma and the DS intro. I just sent a Figma org invite to noah@redwood.com, check spam/Other tab. If it errors with `SSO_error` DM me your exact work email. DS walkthrough usually 30m with @samir — want me to put you on today's 4:15 slot?

samir: hi @noah, congrats! Roadmap & PRDs live in Notion > Product. I'll add you to the weekly critique calendar once Notion is sorted. For the DS walkthrough 4:15 works for me  invite sent.

noah: thanks both. I clicked the Figma link and it says "Request access". Notion still 403. 4:15 is perfect.

amy: `Request access` usually means the SSO didn't auto-add you. I'm re-triggering a manual add now. If you still see that, reply with the exact error text. Meanwhile pinned starter assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED

it-bot: :key: Access ticket created: IT-5632 for Notion group sync for noah@redwood.com. ETA 6-8 hours.

samir: research templates are in Drive > UX > Templates (consent_standard_v3.docx, screener_template.md, moderated_guide.md). We link research notes to Notion pages for taxonomy. For recordings: Drive > UX Recordings and we add the Notion research note with a link + tags. If Notion is blocked, drop notes in Drive and we'll migrate.

research-ops: Adding: recruitment flow is internal panel or vendor. For paid participants use the Research Payment form (Drive > UX) and cc research-ops@redwood.com. Legal reviews consent for external recruitment. If you want to shadow a session, we have a moderated interview at 11:30 tomorrow  I can add you as observer.

noah: appreciate it. Small thing — any preferred filename pattern for research notes?

samir: use `YYYYMMDD_feature_persona_sessionID` for the Notion title and include tags in the metadata block (persona, prototype, moderated/unmoderated). Example: `20260315_search-onboarding_SME_042`.

amy: Figma access fixed — you should be able to join the org now. Let me know if you still see `Request access`. I also dropped a short onboarding checklist in your DMs with links to Playbooks and the critique calendar.

noah: I can get into Figma now, thanks! Notion still 403 but IT ticket logged. I'll join the DS walkthrough at 4:15 and would love to shadow the 11:30 session tomorrow.

it-bot: :white_check_mark: IT-5632 updated: Notion group sync in progress; will notify thread when complete.

research-ops: Done — added @noah as observer to the 11:30 session. Welcome aboard and see you in the walkthrough!

noah: Thanks all  huge help. I'll post here if Notion still blocks after EOD.
